tasks.name: fleet-digests
tasks.cmd:
set -eu
ledger=fleet/release-refs.toml
if [ ! -f "$ledger" ]; then
  echo "fleet digests: release-ref ledger '$ledger' not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
found=0
plan_output=$(mktemp)
digest_output=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$plan_output" "$digest_output"' EXIT
for f in fleet/policies/*-desired-policy.json; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  found=1
  cargo run -p velnor-tools --locked --quiet -- fleet-policy plan --policy "$f" --ledger "$ledger" >"$plan_output"
  digest=$(sed -n 's/^digest: //p' "$plan_output")
  printf '%s -> %s
' "$(basename "$f" -desired-policy.json)" "$digest" >>"$digest_output"
done
if [ "$found" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "fleet digests: no *-desired-policy.json under fleet/policies/" >&2
  echo "fleet digests: run rtk mise run fleet-generate to produce fleet/policies/<org>-desired-policy.json" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cat "$digest_output"
tasks.leaf_identity: set -eu ledger=fleet/release-refs.toml if [ ! -f "$ledger" ]; then echo "fleet digests: release-ref ledger '$ledger' not found" >&2 exit 1 fi found=0 plan_output=$(mktemp) digest_output=$(mktemp) trap 'rm -f "$plan_output" "$digest_output"' EXIT for f in fleet/policies/*-desired-policy.json; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue found=1 cargo run -p velnor-tools --locked --quiet -- fleet-policy plan --policy "$f" --ledger "$ledger" >"$plan_output" digest=$(sed -n 's/^digest: //p' "$plan_output") printf '%s -> %s ' "$(basename "$f" -desired-policy.json)" "$digest" >>"$digest_output" done if [ "$found" -ne 1 ]; then echo "fleet digests: no *-desired-policy.json under fleet/policies/" >&2 echo "fleet digests: run rtk mise run fleet-generate to produce fleet/policies/<org>-desired-policy.json" >&2 exit 1 fi cat "$digest_output"|dir=.|env=

tasks.name: fleet-generate
tasks.cmd: cargo run -p velnor-tools --locked --quiet -- fleet-policy generate --ledger fleet/release-refs.toml --out-dir fleet/policies
tasks.leaf_identity: cargo run -p velnor-tools --locked --quiet -- fleet-policy generate --ledger fleet/release-refs.toml --out-dir fleet/policies|dir=.|env=

tasks.name: fleet-plan
tasks.cmd:
set -eu
ledger=fleet/release-refs.toml
if [ ! -f "$ledger" ]; then
  echo "fleet plan: release-ref ledger '$ledger' not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
found=0
for f in fleet/policies/*-desired-policy.json; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  found=1
  echo "== $f =="
  cargo run -p velnor-tools --locked --quiet -- fleet-policy plan --policy "$f" --ledger "$ledger"
done
if [ "$found" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "fleet plan: no *-desired-policy.json under fleet/policies/" >&2
  echo "fleet plan: run rtk mise run fleet-generate to produce fleet/policies/<org>-desired-policy.json" >&2
  exit 1
fi
tasks.leaf_identity: set -eu ledger=fleet/release-refs.toml if [ ! -f "$ledger" ]; then echo "fleet plan: release-ref ledger '$ledger' not found" >&2 exit 1 fi found=0 for f in fleet/policies/*-desired-policy.json; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue found=1 echo "== $f ==" cargo run -p velnor-tools --locked --quiet -- fleet-policy plan --policy "$f" --ledger "$ledger" done if [ "$found" -ne 1 ]; then echo "fleet plan: no *-desired-policy.json under fleet/policies/" >&2 echo "fleet plan: run rtk mise run fleet-generate to produce fleet/policies/<org>-desired-policy.json" >&2 exit 1 fi|dir=.|env=
